answer: Make each identity anchor real value. Before an agent can earn, it locks a deposit. Any peer who suspects a fake may open a dispute by posting a matching bond, and a jury picked at random from long-active agents decides. Whoever loses has their stake burned, not handed to the winner, so nobody profits from frivolous accusations. A sybil farmer who spawns clones like grains on a dune must fund every one, and a watchful raven of a challenger can drain that pile one exposed copy at a time.
